verdict.rationale: Bento documents its own framework integrations: a Google ADK extra that captures every call automatically, SDK-level capture of LLM calls, and a stated distinction between integrated SDKs and manual events for SDKs without one. It also claims to capture spans from every framework over OpenTelemetry. However, no named integration for LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK appears in the evidence. missing for 10: documented LangChain integration, documented OpenAI SDK integration, documented Vercel AI SDK integration, a published list of supported frameworks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK
